We know that climate change and global warming are affecting weather patterns on a global scale. Yet, at the local level, weather patterns can sometimes differ and follow different patterns than those soon globally. 

Changes in weather patterns can greatly affect local ecosystems. It is important to observe and understand how the effects of climate change are impacting a specific area because each location will be affected differently. 

This dashboard uses temperature and rainfall data to explore how weather patterns in Sewanee, Tennessee, have changed over time. Users can view long-term trends as well as directly compare specific years. This information can help reveal potential shifts in local climate patterns associated with climate change.


[See how to use the dashboard and explore the data here!](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jb156qFFj94B59KLo2wGZ26R9PiAJHcK/view?usp=sharing)
